operations.note: Service categories and pages ride inside the same mirrored content document the tool returns.

operations.apiOnly: The OpenAPI document itself. Agents discover the REST surface from it; there is no MCP tool for reading the tool list — tools/list is that mechanism.
OAuth discovery metadata (RFC 9728). The MCP worker serves the same metadata for its own resource; neither is a tool.
Plain-text agent index for the API host. The MCP surface's equivalent is tools/list; no tool serves it.

rule: No system change ships without its MCP + skills updates in the same change (standing rule, 2026-10-26). This map is the agents repo's half of that contract: every served OpenAPI operation names its MCP tool (or the reason it has none), every MCP tool names its operation (or the reason it has none), and tools/check-coverage.mjs fails CI when the code, this map, the skills, the connector guides, the docs, or the SDK drift apart. The website repo carries the matching half in specs/004-api-mcp/agent-surface-inventory.json; the operation and tool names must match exactly.

toolsWithoutOperation.reason: Search is an MCP-side composition over the mirrored FAQ, categories, and pod presentation. The REST equivalents are GET /v1/faq and GET /v1/content; there is deliberately no separate REST search operation, so agents on REST compose the same sources.
